post.caption: This tiara was an 18th birthday gift. In 1936 the Duke of York bought this tiara for his wife, and Cartier London sold it about three weeks before he became king. It holds 739 brilliant-cut diamonds and 149 baguette-cut diamonds, in a band of 16 graduated scrolls. In 1944 the Queen Mother gave it to Princess Elizabeth at eighteen. Princess Margaret wore it at the coronation in June 1953, and Princess Anne wore it from 1967 until her wedding in 1973. In 2011 the Queen lent it to Catherine Middleton for her wedding, and she wore it to hold her wedding veil in place.
